source.publicationAuthorization: Project owner authorized continued website publication on 2026-09-01. Independent specialist approval remains a separate project-control field and is not implied by publication.
source.releaseTimeReview: THC-ENC-306–310 were reconciled against 2026 hemp damping-off guidance; direct 2026 Cannabis-Sclerotinia cellular/transcriptomic research; 2026 Cannabis Septoria germplasm trials; direct Alternaria and bacterial hemp pathogenicity reports; current Cannabis endophyte/pathogen reviews; and 2024–2025 HLVd transmission, tissue-distribution, detection, and aphid-acquisition studies. Public wording keeps syndrome, organism detection, causal pathogenicity, vector acquisition, proven transmission, and regulated-product authorization separate.
source.note: This batch extends controlled Volume 16 with damping-off/Rhizoctonia differentials, Sclerotinia white mold, foliar pathogen differentiation, bacterial/opportunistic disease, and hop latent viroid.
